Do NOT copy any player, name, number, score or date from that style example. Do not make a photographic or photorealistic collage.

The sole person MUST depict the real basketball player Keegan Records (キーガン・レコード), whose official B.LEAGUE portrait has just been viewed in this conversation. Reference is for his physical likeness only, not to paste the official photograph. Closely preserve these visible traits: fair skin, large tall strong athletic build and broad shoulders; short straight medium-brown hair neatly swept to his right with a soft side part and slightly raised front; high broad forehead; moderately thick dark eyebrows; slightly hooded eyes; long oval/angular face; straight prominent nose with rounded tip; broad mouth; squared rounded chin; nearly clean-shaven with only very light jaw stubble, NO full beard. Scene/composition: a dynamic three-quarter view of Records alone on the RIGHT 45% of the canvas, knees flexed and torso rotating into a strong basketball pivot, both hands naturally gripping ONE orange basketball in front of his lower chest/waist, looking toward the left with focused game energy. Head, both arms, hands and ball entirely inside the frame, generous 6% padding. Crop his lower body around mid-thigh naturally at lower right if needed. Broad diagonal lime brushstrokes behind the player with a small amount of ink splatter, no busy crowd, no extra players, no scoreboard, no reconstructed game scene.

Use superb Japanese typesetting, large glyphs, ample line spacing, crisp edges, no clipping and a minimum 5% safe text margin. Footer must not touch the lower edge.

This is a representative imaginative basketball illustration. Keegan Records was selected RANDOMLY from the article's named players, not singled out as the article's main star. No team logos, league logos, official photo pixels, watermarks, decorative fake letters, additional text, championship claims or match-winning shot claims.
